# 设置识别距离
##### 简要描述

- URI中的ChannelID表示通道编号，对于IPC来说，ChannelID固定为1

<br>
**XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| ChannelID | integer | 通道号，对于IPC来说，ChannelID固定为1 | 否 |
| Distance | integer | 识别距离，单位:厘米 | 否 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceRecognition/1/RecoDistance HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 1b71390d-e633-451b-b503-083cfb007490
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 154

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceRecoDistance Version="1.0">
<ChannelID>1</ChannelID>
<Distance>100</Distance>
</FaceRecoDistance>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 197

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceRecognition/1/RecoDistance</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

PUT HTTP请求示例
PUT /FaceRecognition/1/RecoDistance HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.26.10
Accept: _/_
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: d7e5cf04-2a97-4b87-801a-38bfcc240c0a
Host: 192.168.1.100
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 124

\<FaceRecoDistance>
\<Distance>1500\</Distance>
\</FaceRecoDistance>

PUT HTTP响应示例
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.0
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 191

\<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
\<requestURL>/FaceRecognition/1/RecoDistance\</requestURL>
\<statusCode>0\</statusCode>
\<message>none\</message>
\</ResponseStatus>

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceRecognition/ChannelID/RecoDistance`

- put
